items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some recordings with Barbra Streisand, Johnny Mathis.

ctx.x: In terms of recordings, did you do much recording throughout your early career? Not all that much?

I recorded – I did a lot of recordings with people on records where I didn’t play anything in particular. I had no solo things, but we used to – I did some recordings with Barbra Streisand, Johnny Mathis.
So this was during the years you were doing jingles, in the ’60s.
